shared_elements: low relief carving of figures against blank ground
bearded male figure with elaborately curled/patterned hair and beard
figure holding an object in a raised hand
detailed rendering of hair, beard and garment by repeated incised patterning
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile, carved in shallow relief on a plain ground, with hair, beard and garment textures rendered by dense repeated incision, and figures whose hands hold or gesture with objects. But A depicts a single large winged figure with great feathered wings filling the field, whereas B depicts a file of many wingless, hat-wearing attendants of differing sizes processing in a row, one behind another, with no wings anywhere.
